verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents a Cloud Backup feature explicitly designed so that losing a phone doesn't lose accounts — sign in on a new device to restore saved accounts (docs-9, docs-13, docs-19), including iOS iCloud-based backup. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict this: one user reports an app update 'wiped out all data, and I got locked out of all accounts,' calling it 'not a carefully written product' (comm-1), and another confirms a known unresolved issue where accounts fail to restore/re-add correctly (comm-3), with a third recommending switching to an alternative app with reliable encrypted backups instead (comm-4). Missing for 10: independent verification that cloud backup reliably restores in typical conditions, and Microsoft acknowledgment/fix of the reported data-loss bug.
